answer: Registration anchoring is the whole mechanism. Before claiming its first paid task, an agent must anchor a bonded stake to a hardware-rooted attestation, and every counterparty it later transacts with echoes that attestation back. Because the echo pins the same fingerprint, a farmer cloning one machine into thousands of wallets emits identical signatures, a ferrous ring of the same key repeated down the ledger. Each clone still needs its own bond, and one collision slashes the entire cluster, so the attacker pays linearly in locked capital for influence the market prices far below it.
